gcp_cloudcdn_cookie_ttl.summary: Reduce this backend service's declared cookie-affinity lifetime to 30 minutes or less.
steps: Inspect sessionAffinity and affinityCookieTtlSec on the exact backend service, and check whether consistentHash.httpCookie.ttl separately overrides the effective cookie lifetime.
Review session persistence needs with the application owner, then set the reviewed backend affinityCookieTtlSec to at most 1800 seconds for GENERATED_COOKIE or HTTP_COOKIE mode.
Test sign-in and backend routing over the shorter lifetime, read back the field, recollect and rerun this check.
caveats: Reducing cookie lifetime may increase rebalancing or disrupt sticky sessions; test the application before changing the backend service.
The signed predicate measures affinityCookieTtlSec only. It does not prove expiry after inactivity, and a consistentHash.httpCookie.ttl override can determine the effective cookie lifetime.
